method: Hex-Rays C parsing: every `case <int>:` / `if (<code> == <int>)` / `if (<code> != <int>) <guard>; <body>` dispatch branch is located, the branch body is brace/terminator delimited, and every `base + n` / `*(T *)(base + n)` / `base[n]` address expression is converted to a byte offset using the declared element size of the base variable (integer locals/params address bytes, pointer locals address pointee-sized elements).  Delegation to base-class get_prop / set_prop is followed up to depth 3.
